title: UNTIL HE TO WHOM IT BELONGS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'The sceptre will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.'" — Gen 49:10 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This is one of the great Messianic prophecies of the Old Testament, and it is already fulfilled.

Jacob says the ruler's staff will stay with Judah until one comes to whom it truly belongs — and that when He comes, the obedience of the nations will be His.

Follow the line. From Judah came David, Israel's greatest king. From David's line, centuries later, came Jesus of Nazareth. Matthew opens his Gospel by tracing exactly this descent (Matt 1:1-3). The rule that ran through Judah arrives at Christ and stops there, because it has reached the One it always belonged to.

And notice the reach of it: the obedience of the nations. Not Israel only. Jacob is dying in Egypt with twelve sons around him, and God gives him a glimpse of a King who will draw people from every nation on earth.

That prophecy is being fulfilled every time someone anywhere bows to Christ. It will be completed on the day every knee bows and every tongue confesses that Jesus Christ is Lord (Phil 2:10-11).

The sceptre belongs to Him. The only question is whether we have gladly acknowledged it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How does it strengthen your faith to see a promise made in Genesis fulfilled in Christ?
2. Have you personally submitted to Christ's rule, or only admired it?
3. What area of your life have you not yet placed under His authority?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, the sceptre belongs to You, and one day every nation will acknowledge it. I gladly bow to You now. Rule in every part of my life. Amen.
